summary.zh-Hant: 德軍佔領華沙，俄屬波蘭失守
summary.en: German troops take Warsaw; Russian Poland lost

citations.evidenceNote: 駐彼得格勒大使 1915-08-31 報告：「the evacuation of Warsaw and the withdrawal of the Russians from the fortress of Kovno」。

timeNote.zh-Hant: 8 月 5 日德軍入城為通行說法；華沙、盧布林總督府 8 月底至 10 月才正式設立（OHM 起日 9-01／10-18），本表從華沙陷落起算。
timeNote.en: Warsaw entered on 5 Aug per common accounts; the general governments were set up Aug–Oct (OHM starts 1 Sep / 18 Oct).
